description.narrative: Ambassaden har behov av att kunna finansiera mindre biståndsrelaterade aktiviteter vilka faller utanför de direkta insatserna men som bedöms vara relevanta och strategiska för utvecklingssamarbetet i Burkina Faso. Det kan t.ex. vara upphandling av förberedande studier, konsultinsatser för att utveckla besluts- och finansieringsunderlag, extra revisioner, översättningar, lokala seminarier eller liknande. Medel har avsatts för detta under tidigare år och det bedöms angeläget att fortsatt ha tillgång till dylik finansiering. Sidas riktlinjer avseende villkor för viss finansiering via sakanslag ska tillämpas.

As part of the Sweden-Burkina Faso 2018-2022 cooperation strategy, the Embassy has identified a need to finance short term activities in relation to the Swedish funded development cooperation programmes in Burkian Faso, such as, procurement of preparatory studies, development of underlying documents, extra audits, translation of documents and local seminars and events. These activities fall outside of direct contributions, but are still deemed to be important and strategic for the overall development cooperation with Burkina Faso. As in previous years, it is proposed that such activities are covered by a Programme Development Fund. Sida’s Guidelines on conditions for using the operational appropriation will be applied.

PUM was a combined contribution for studies and evaluations to develop the strategy portfolio. An organisational audit have been done through this contribution by the firm Ernst and Young. Sida's frame work agreement for audit have been used to select the firm.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
